src/integrations/sync/trainingpeaks.rs.description: check_upload_status() polls GET /v1/file/{upload_id} for async upload processing status. Returns UploadStatus enum: Processing (still processing), Ready{file_id} (complete), Error{error} (failed), Duplicate{error} (duplicate detected). Same polling pattern as Strava but uses file_id instead of activity_id.

src/integrations/sync/oauth.rs.description: TrainingPeaks OAuth uses standard OAuth2 with expires_in (seconds until expiry) rather than expires_at (Unix timestamp) like Strava. Token endpoint at oauth.trainingpeaks.com/oauth/token requires redirect_uri in token exchange request. Error responses use standard OAuth2 error/error_description format.
